caption:
Your battery offer is one checkbox on a quote form.

The people most likely to add a battery already have your panels. A tiny checkbox doesn't tell them anything.

Give batteries their own page:
→ Speak to people who already have solar ("Already have panels? Add a battery.")
→ Say what it does in plain words: charges in the day, you use it at night
→ Answer "will it work with mine?": inverter, where it goes, backup in a power cut
→ Show a rough price range, then one button: "Book a battery check"

Then send that page to every past customer.

(Illustration of a generic site, not a real installer.)
